---
title: "Our file drawer"
format:
  html:
    theme:
      - cosmo
      - ../styles.scss
    css:
      - stylesDrawer.css
---

```{=html}
<div class="drawer-page" data-view="mine">
  <section class="drawer-archive" aria-labelledby="drawer-title">
    <div class="drawer-heading">
      <div class="drawer-heading-copy">
        <h1 id="drawer-title">
          <span data-for="mine">My file drawer</span>
          <span data-for="community">Community’s<br>file drawer</span>
        </h1>
        <p class="drawer-subtitle" data-for="mine">The projects I started, loved and left behind.</p>
        <p class="drawer-subtitle" data-for="community">Everyone has one. Add the projects you abandoned, so they are not forgotten.</p>
      </div>
      <button class="drawer-refresh" id="drawer-refresh" data-for="community" type="button" aria-label="Refresh archive" title="Refresh archive">↻</button>
    </div>
    <div class="drawer-margin-arrow" data-for="community" aria-hidden="true">
      <svg viewBox="0 0 120 1000" preserveAspectRatio="none" focusable="false">
        <path class="drawer-margin-arrow-line" d="M109 16 C39 10 25 91 22 190 C18 309 29 405 19 525 C10 642 22 735 25 825 C27 886 36 928 51 958"></path>
        <path class="drawer-margin-arrow-head" d="M24 925 C33 939 41 950 52 961 C59 944 66 928 74 915"></path>
      </svg>
    </div>
    <div class="drawer-showcase">
      <div class="drawer-lists">
        <div class="drawer-projects" id="my-projects" data-for="mine" role="tabpanel" aria-labelledby="cabinet-mine" aria-live="polite"></div>
        <div class="drawer-projects" id="drawer-projects" data-for="community" role="tabpanel" aria-labelledby="cabinet-community" aria-live="polite" aria-busy="true">
          <div class="drawer-loading"><span></span><span></span><span></span><p>Opening the drawer…</p></div>
        </div>
        <a class="drawer-cta" data-for="community" href="#leave-a-project">Add your abandoned project <span aria-hidden="true">↓</span></a>
      </div>
      <div class="drawer-side-art">
        <div class="drawer-cabinets" role="tablist" aria-label="File drawers">
          <button class="drawer-cabinet drawer-cabinet--mine" id="cabinet-mine" type="button" role="tab" aria-selected="true" aria-controls="my-projects" data-view="mine" aria-label="My file drawer">
            <img src="assets/drawer-cabinet.png" alt="">
            <span class="drawer-cabinet-label">My file drawer</span>
          </button>
          <button class="drawer-cabinet drawer-cabinet--community" id="cabinet-community" type="button" role="tab" aria-selected="false" aria-controls="drawer-projects" data-view="community" aria-label="Community’s file drawer">
            <span class="drawer-cabinet-hint" data-for="mine" aria-hidden="true">
              <span class="drawer-cabinet-hint-text">open me!</span>
              <svg viewBox="0 0 64 56" focusable="false">
                <path class="drawer-cabinet-hint-line" d="M50 8 C30 6 15 18 12 46"></path>
                <path class="drawer-cabinet-hint-head" d="M4 38 C7 42 10 46 12 49 C15 45 18 41 22 38"></path>
              </svg>
            </span>
            <img src="assets/drawer-cabinet.png" alt="">
            <span class="drawer-cabinet-label">Community’s file drawer</span>
          </button>
        </div>
      </div>
    </div>
  </section>

  <section class="drawer-form-section" id="leave-a-project" data-for="community" aria-labelledby="form-title">
    <div class="drawer-form-intro">
      <h2 id="form-title">What did you leave in the drawer?</h2>
      <p>Share as much or as little as feels right. Your name is optional.</p>
    </div>

    <form class="drawer-form" id="drawer-form" novalidate>
      <div class="drawer-field drawer-field-wide">
        <label for="project-title">Project title <span class="required-marker" aria-hidden="true">*</span></label>
        <input id="project-title" name="title" type="text" maxlength="120" autocomplete="off" required placeholder="What was its short title?">
      </div>

      <div class="drawer-field">
        <label for="project-topic">Field or topic <span class="required-marker" aria-hidden="true">*</span></label>
        <input id="project-topic" name="topic" type="text" maxlength="80" autocomplete="off" required placeholder="e.g. social psychology">
      </div>

      <div class="drawer-field">
        <label for="project-stage">Where did it stop? <span class="required-marker" aria-hidden="true">*</span></label>
        <select id="project-stage" name="stage" required>
          <option value="">Choose a stage</option>
          <option value="idea">At the idea</option>
          <option value="planning">During planning</option>
          <option value="data">During data collection</option>
          <option value="analysis">During data analysis</option>
          <option value="writing">During writing</option>
          <option value="other">Somewhere else</option>
        </select>
      </div>

      <div class="drawer-field drawer-field-year">
        <label for="project-year">Year abandoned <span class="required-marker" aria-hidden="true">*</span></label>
        <input id="project-year" name="abandoned_year" type="number" min="1900" inputmode="numeric" required placeholder="e.g. 2024">
      </div>

      <div class="drawer-field drawer-field-wide">
        <label for="project-description">Tell us its story <span class="required-marker" aria-hidden="true">*</span></label>
        <textarea id="project-description" name="description" rows="6" maxlength="1200" required placeholder="What was the question? What happened? What, if anything, stayed with you?"></textarea>
        <p class="drawer-character-count"><span id="description-count">0</span> / 1200</p>
      </div>

      <div class="drawer-field drawer-field-wide">
        <label for="display-name">Your name <span>optional</span></label>
        <input id="display-name" name="display_name" type="text" maxlength="80" autocomplete="name" placeholder="Leave blank to file it anonymously">
      </div>

      <div class="drawer-honeypot" aria-hidden="true">
        <label for="project-website">Website</label>
        <input id="project-website" name="website" type="text" tabindex="-1" autocomplete="off">
      </div>

      <label class="drawer-consent">
        <input name="consent" type="checkbox" required>
        <span>I understand that this text may appear publicly after review.</span>
      </label>

      <div class="drawer-submit-row">
        <button class="drawer-submit" type="submit">File this project <span aria-hidden="true">→</span></button>
        <p class="drawer-form-status" id="drawer-form-status" role="status" aria-live="polite"></p>
      </div>
      <p class="drawer-privacy-note">Please do not include confidential, identifying or sensitive participant information.</p>
    </form>
  </section>
</div>

<script src="assets/drawer-config.js"></script>
<script src="assets/my-drawer.js"></script>
<script src="assets/drawer.js"></script>
```
